brief:
Israel's military campaign in Gaza has cost over $140 billion, according to Middle East Eye's review of Israeli press reporting. The figure reflects the sustained financial toll of operations that have continued into the territory's third year of conflict, with economic impacts spanning defense spending, infrastructure damage, and displaced population support.

The cost assessment emerged as Israeli authorities took control of an UNRWA school and clinic in Gaza, marking another institutional shift in the territory's governance structure. The moves signal continued changes to Gaza's administrative landscape as the conflict persists without resolution.

title: Israeli military operations in Gaza exceed $140 billion in costs
